name: Tower Of Penguinaria
detailed_description:
General:
Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica. 
What Makes This Game Different:

In addition to being a Rougelite, RPG, Dungeon Crawler, Timeloop, game (where character stats improve based on what you wear). Depending on what you wear will change what you're move set in the turn based combat will do!
There is also a death loop feature. Dying will make you enter Kenos (land of the dead) where you can unlock metaprogression to give yourself more time, or power, to defeat the Sealsorer who lurks on top of the Tower.
Finally a mix of unique enemies, traps, and bosses makes even crawling on this randomly generated 2d dungeon engaging. Timing runs over dangerous spikes, dodging meteors, and blocking attacks on the game map, before heading into the battlefield keeps crawling dynamic and fun!

Game Loop:
Enter the dungeon to get xp and money
Buy new gear to get further (and unlock checkpoints)

perish or run out of time, allowing you to spend those hard earned levels on permanent buffs

Credits:
Developer: RpgPenguin
Artists: RpgPenguin, BlueIsTopia
